title: Is double venous anastomosis better than single venous anastomosis in head and neck reconstruction with free flaps? A systematic review and meta-analysis
html: Venous complications are the main cause of flap loss and revision in free flap surgery. Although a second venous anastomosis has been proposed to improve drainage, its efficacy remains debated. The aim of this review was to assess whether performing two venous anastomoses is associated with a reduced risk of flap loss. Secondary objectives were the evaluation of venous compromise, revision rates, and outcomes by flap type. This systematic review was conducted in accordance with the PRISMA criteria, utilizing the Web of Science, PubMed Central, and Cochrane Library databases.
